DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 午後の納品記録は、どの表へ入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which sheet did you enter the afternoon delivery record on?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 机の上の工程表へ十箱と記入しました。ただ、後で昨日の日付だと気付きました。古い表へ書いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十箱を昨日の工程表へ誤記した疑いを責任者へ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote ten boxes on the schedule on the desk, but later noticed it had yesterday's date. I may have written on an old sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report to the supervisor that you may have mistakenly recorded ten boxes on yesterday's schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の記録用は、右側の青い見出しの表です。古い表はまだ残してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today's record sheet is the one on the right with a blue heading. Have you kept the old sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 残しています。間違いを隠すつもりで消すのはやめ、十箱と書いた位置が分かるようにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧表を保存し誤記位置を消さず残していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I didn't erase it to hide the mistake; I've left it so you can see where I wrote ten boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you kept the old sheet and left the mistaken entry visible without erasing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際に受け取った数と、表に書いた数を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the number actually received separately from the number written on the sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実物は十箱受け取りました。古い表に十箱を書きましたが、今日の青い表にはまだ一箱も記入していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実受領十箱旧表十箱今日表未記入を分けて報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I actually received ten boxes. I wrote ten boxes on the old sheet, but haven't entered even one on today's blue sheet yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report separately ten boxes received, ten written on the old sheet, and no entry on today's sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、私と納品書を照合した後、今日の欄へ一度だけ記録してください。旧版への記入は訂正として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking the delivery slip with me, record it only once in today's column. We'll retain the old version's entry as a correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 納品書も十箱です。今日の表へ移す時、追加で十箱届いたように二重計上しないよう、一回の納品として記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 納品書照合後は二重計上せず一回の納品として記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: The delivery slip also says ten boxes. When moving it to today's sheet, I'll record one delivery so it isn't counted twice as if ten more boxes arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After checking the delivery slip, record one delivery without double counting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の欄は十箱になりました。旧版は使用しない資料として分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today's column now says ten boxes. We'll store the old version separately as a document that is no longer used.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の記録を確認しました。次の納品では机の位置だけで選ばず、日付と見出しを見てから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日記録確認後は位置だけで選ばず日付見出しで記入先を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked today's record. For the next delivery, I won't choose just by where the sheet is on the desk; I'll check its date and heading before writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking today's record, decide where to write by date and heading rather than location alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 報告してくれて助かりました。それでは、午前分の照合へ戻ります。午後もよろしくお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thanks for reporting it; that helped. I'll return to checking the morning records. Thank you for your work this afternoon too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取引履歴についてのご相談ですね。どの点を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about your transaction history. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を送ったつもりですが、大家さんから届いていないと連絡がありました。履歴には振替とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃未着連絡と履歴の振替表示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd sent the rent, but my landlord said it hasn't arrived. The history says “account transfer.”
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the landlord's report of missing rent and the account-transfer entry in the history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振替という言葉だけで、家賃の振込が完了したとは判断できません。ご自身の別口座へ動かした可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: The word “account transfer” alone does not establish that the rent payment is complete. Could you have moved money to another account of your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段使う口座と貯金用の口座を持っています。貯金用から出したところまでは覚えていますが、大家さんの口座を選んだ記憶はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人二口座と貯金用から動かした記憶だけを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an everyday account and a savings account. I remember moving it out of savings, but don't remember selecting the landlord's account.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your two accounts and that you only remember moving money out of savings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が、どの口座からどの口座へ動いた記録か確認します。確認の前に、同じ額をもう一度送らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check which accounts the record shows the money moving between. Do not send the same amount again before that check.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 履歴を見てからにします。未着の連絡だけで二重に送るのは避けたいので、まず今回の移動先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複送金を避け今回移動先の記録確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait until I've seen the history. I want to avoid paying twice just because it was reported missing, so first I want to know where this transfer went.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize checking the recorded destination to avoid a duplicate payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。今回は、ご本人の貯金用から普段使う口座への移動です。家賃の振込先への記録ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've confirmed it. This was a move from your savings to your everyday account, not a record of payment to the rent recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の口座間で止まっていたのですね。大家さんには送金完了と言ってしまったので、確認結果を訂正して連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人間移動だったと理解し大家への完了報告を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it had only moved between my own accounts. I told the landlord the payment was complete, so I'll contact them to correct that with the confirmed result.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand that the move was between your own accounts and correct your completion report to the landlord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新たな振込のご希望は、振込先と金額を、ご本人で確かめてから担当へお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want a new bank transfer, please check the recipient and amount yourself before asking the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に大家さんの指定口座と今月分の金額を確認します。今回の振替と、これから行う家賃の振込を別々にメモして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家賃口座金額を確認し本人振替と新たな振込を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first check the landlord's designated account and this month's amount. I'll note this account transfer separately from the rent payment I'm about to make and discuss them.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the rent account and amount and discuss your internal transfer separately from the new rent payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、振込の担当へおつなぎします。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll connect you to the bank-transfer staff member. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちのきっぷについて、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家から急な連絡があり、私は今日の旅行をやめます。友人と二人で行く予定でしたが、友人の分まで取り消したいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人だけの旅行中止を申し出て同行者分の取消しは求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Something urgent came up at home, so I'm canceling my trip today. I was going with a friend, but I don't want to cancel their ticket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are canceling the trip and you are not asking to cancel your companion's ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人のきっぷは、それぞれお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do each of you have your own ticket with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が二枚まとめて持っています。私はまだ受け取っていないので、自分の分を確認してから手続きしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚が友人の手元にあり本人券を確認して手続きしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend has both tickets together. I haven't received mine yet, so I'd like to check my own ticket before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend holds both tickets and you want to check your own before proceeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象のきっぷを確認して、取扱いをご案内します。お友達には中止することをお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the relevant ticket and explain the procedure. Have you told your friend you are canceling?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 言い出しにくくて、まだです。でも、友人を待たせたままにせず、今から私だけ帰ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 言い出しにくさを認め友人へ本人だけ帰ると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found it difficult to bring up, so not yet. But I won't leave them waiting; I'll tell them now that only I am going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it is difficult to say and contact your friend to explain that only you are going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでご連絡ください。お友達が旅行を続けるかは、ご本人とご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please contact them here. Discuss with your friend whether they will continue the trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人へ伝えました。友人は一人で行くそうです。私の分だけ渡しに来てくれるので、二枚とも返してもらうようには頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の旅行継続を受け本人券だけを渡してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've told them. They say they will go alone. They'll bring only my ticket, so I won't ask them to return both tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After your friend decides to continue, explain that you will receive only your own ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その一枚を拝見してから、払い戻しできるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After seeing that one ticket, we'll check whether a refund is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻るお金があると先に決めず、きっぷを見てもらいます。友人には旅行を楽しんでほしいと伝え、自分は帰る準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 払い戻し可否を先に断定せず券確認を待って本人帰宅を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have you check the ticket without assuming there will be money back. I'll tell my friend I hope they enjoy the trip and prepare to go home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume a refund is possible; wait for the ticket check and prepare to go home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご本人のきっぷをお持ちになりましたらお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please let us know when you have your own ticket. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は、どのようなことを相談したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: しゃっくりです。人に話すと笑われそうで言いにくかったのですが、昨日から何度も出て、食事の途中で困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 繰り返すしゃっくりを恥ずかしさと食事への影響を含め相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hiccups. I found it hard to say because I thought people might laugh, but they've happened repeatedly since yesterday and are bothering me during meals.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about repeated hiccups, including embarrassment and their effect on eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 続いている様子を診療担当へ伝えます。昨日は、一日中止まらなかったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the medical staff how they have continued. Did they continue all day yesterday without stopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ずっとではありません。止まる時間もありますが、しばらくするとまた出ます。今だけ止まっているので、困っていないとは思わないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連続ではなく休止と再発があり現在止まっても困り事は続くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not continuously. There are times they stop, but they start again after a while. They've only stopped right now, so I don't want that to mean I'm not having difficulties.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are pauses and recurrences rather than continuous hiccups, and the problem remains even though they have stopped now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 止まる時間もあるのですね。生活の中で、ほかに困った場面はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there are periods when they stop. Are there any other situations in daily life where they cause problems?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話で話す途中にも出て、相手へ話しかけているのか分かりにくくなりました。食事だけの問題ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話の会話にも支障がある具体例を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They also happen during phone conversations, making it hard for the other person to tell whether I'm addressing them. It's not only a problem with eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give a specific example of difficulty with phone conversations too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのことも申し送ります。ご自身で試したことや、使用した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that on too. Have you tried anything yourself or used any products?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同僚に教わった方法を試しましたが、何か薬を飲んだわけではありません。詳しい内容は先生に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚の方法を試したが薬使用なしと述べ診察で詳しく話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I tried a method a colleague suggested, but I haven't taken any medicine. I'll explain the details to the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you tried a colleague's method without taking medicine and will explain the details at the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察で、続く様子と試したことをお伝えください。ここで原因を決めたり、止め方を指示したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: During the consultation, explain how they have continued and what you tried. We won't decide the cause or instruct you how to stop them here.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。軽い相談だと自分で決めず、昨日から繰り返すことと、食事や電話で困ることを先生へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 軽症を自己断定せず反復時期と生活支障を医師へ説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't decide myself that it's a minor issue; I'll tell the doctor they've recurred since yesterday and cause problems with eating and phone calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not conclude yourself that it is mild; explain the recurrence timing and daily-life effects to the doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でおつなぎします。それでは、診察のご案内までお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll refer you with that information. Please wait for the consultation instructions. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝に出したいので、この青いバナナが一晩で黄色くなるなら買いたいです。明朝ちょうどよい状態になると約束できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明朝用の青いバナナが一晩で熟す保証を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to serve these tomorrow morning, so I'd buy these green bananas if they'll turn yellow overnight. Can you promise they'll be just right tomorrow morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether green bananas for tomorrow morning are guaranteed to ripen overnight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明朝の状態までお約束することはできません。今の状態を見て、お選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot promise their condition tomorrow morning. You can choose based on how they are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 翌朝の色を必ず決められるものではないのですね。五房買う予定でしたが、その見込みだけで大量には買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌朝状態を断定できないと理解し五房の大量購入をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you can't be certain what color they'll be the next morning. I planned to buy five bunches, but I won't buy that many based only on that expectation.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that tomorrow morning's condition cannot be guaranteed and decide against buying five bunches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数と、ほかに用意する物に合わせて数量をお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider the quantity based on how many people will eat and what else you will prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四人で食べます。ほかにもパンを用意するので、まず今見て選べる一房にします。バナナだけで全員分を埋める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四人でパンもあるため現状で選ぶ一房へ数量を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are four of us. We'll also have bread, so for now I'll choose one bunch based on what I can see. Bananas don't need to provide everyone's whole portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since four people will also have bread, limit the purchase to one bunch chosen by its current condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの一房をお取りしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Shall I take this bunch for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で見て選びます。表側だけでなく、裏側にも傷がないか確かめたいです。触った物を何度もほかの房へ混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表裏の傷を見て選びむやみに他房へ混ぜないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look and choose myself. I'd like to check the back for damage as well as the front. I won't keep mixing bunches I've touched among the others.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check front and back for damage, and say that you will not unnecessarily mix handled bunches with others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要でしたら、こちらで向きを変えてお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If needed, I can turn it around to show you.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 裏側も見られました。この一房にします。明日の状態が必ずよいと決めず、帰宅して保存の表示も読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 裏側確認後一房を決め翌朝状態を確約とせず保存表示を読むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've seen the back too. I'll take this bunch. Without assuming it will definitely be good tomorrow, I'll also read the storage label when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the back, choose one bunch, do not assume tomorrow's condition is guaranteed, and read the storage label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの一房ですね。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: This bunch, then. Please proceed to checkout. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの飲み物は、店内で召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you have this drink inside the store?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み物は買いますが、昼食は家から持ってきました。この席で弁当を食べてもよいか、開ける前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入飲物と持参弁当を示し開封前に店内席利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll buy the drink, but I brought lunch from home. Before opening it, I'd like to ask whether I can eat my lunchbox at this seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the purchased drink and brought lunchbox, and ask about using the seating before opening it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの席では、お店で購入した品だけをお召し上がりいただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: At these seats, customers may consume only items bought in the store.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飲み物を一つ買えば、自分の弁当も広げられるとは限らないのですね。まだ封を開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲物購入だけでは持参弁当の利用権にならず未開封と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So buying one drink doesn't necessarily mean I can spread out my own lunchbox too. I haven't opened it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that buying a drink does not authorize eating a brought lunchbox and that it is still unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お飲み物は、持ち帰りになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like your drink to take away?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち帰ります。弁当を置くために二つの席を先に取っていましたが、荷物をどけて空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲物持帰りを選び先取りした二席の荷物をどける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take it away. I had already reserved two seats to put my lunchbox down, but I'll remove my belongings and free them.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a takeaway drink and remove belongings from the two seats you had taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。飲み物を先にお会計しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Let's pay for the drink first.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。ここで昼食を食べられないという理由で、買った飲み物を返したいという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席利用断念と購入飲物の返品希望を混同しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'm not saying I want to return the drink I bought just because I can't eat lunch here.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that giving up the seating is separate from wanting to return the purchased drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計が済みました。席に置いた物は、そろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Payment is complete. Have you collected everything you placed on the seats?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 弁当と上着を持ちました。食べる場所は別に探しますが、この店が別の場所も用意してくれるとは考えず自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 弁当上着を回収し別の食事場所は本人が確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've got my lunchbox and jacket. I'll look for somewhere else to eat, but I won't assume this store will provide another place; I'll check myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect the lunchbox and jacket and say that you will check another eating place yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お忘れ物にお気をつけて。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please be careful not to leave anything behind. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の照明について、どんなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What problem are you having with the road lighting?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しく付いた街灯の光が、寝室へ直接入ります。つかない街灯の修理ではなく、点灯している光の向きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未点灯故障でなく新設点灯光が寝室へ入る問題を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Light from a newly installed streetlight shines directly into my bedroom. I'm not asking to repair an unlit lamp; I'd like to discuss the direction of a light that is on.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report direct bedroom light from a new working streetlight, rather than a failure to light up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 街灯を消してほしいというご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like the streetlight switched off?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は全部消してほしいと思いましたが、夜に道を通る方もいます。道の明かりをなくさず、部屋へ入る光を減らせるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全面消灯の初希望を改め通行者の明かりを維持した調整を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: At first I wanted it all switched off, but people use the road at night too. I'd like to ask whether the light entering my room can be reduced without removing the road lighting.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Revise your initial wish for all lights off and request adjustment that preserves light for pedestrians. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理の担当に、調整できるか確認します。室内では、どの部分へ光が入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask the management staff whether it can be adjusted. Which part of the room does the light reach?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベッドの枕の辺りです。カーテンを閉めても上から入ります。ただ、角度を何度変えればよいかは、自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枕付近とカーテン上からの光を述べ具体調整角度は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around the pillow on the bed. Even with the curtains closed, it comes in from above. However, I don't know how many degrees its angle should be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe light near the pillow and above the curtains, and say that you do not know the specific adjustment angle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的な対策は担当の確認が必要です。光の向きをご自身で変えようとはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Specific measures need to be checked by the staff. Do not try to change the direction yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柱や照明へ触れません。明るさを弱めれば必ず解決すると決めず、窓との位置関係も担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設備へ触れず減光だけを万能視せず窓との関係を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't touch the pole or lamp. I won't assume dimming it will definitely solve the problem; I'll also explain its position relative to the window.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not touch the equipment or regard dimming alone as a certain solution; explain its relation to the window. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡先を伺い、対応できる範囲を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take your contact details and explain after checking what action is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を書きました。夜の道を暗くしたいという申し出ではなく、寝室へ直接差す光の相談として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を出し道の消灯でなく室内直射光の相談として引継ぎを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my contact details. Please pass this on as a question about light shining directly into the bedroom, not a request to darken the road at night.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide contact details and ask for referral as a direct indoor-light issue rather than switching off road lighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望で引き継ぎます。それでは、担当からのご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll pass it on with that request. Please wait for information from the staff in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料金四百円を、一千円からお預かりしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I've received one thousand yen for the four-hundred-yen charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。釣銭は六百円だと思いますが、硬貨のほかに千円札も受け取りました。私の勘違いか、まだ混ぜずに見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四百円料金に千円支払い後六百円以外に千円札があると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I think my change should be six hundred yen, but I received a thousand-yen note as well as coins. Could you check whether I'm mistaken before I mix them with my own money?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report receiving a thousand-yen note in addition to six hundred yen after paying one thousand for a four-hundred-yen charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったん、お渡ししたお金を台で確認します。お客様が出されたのは一千円札一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the money I gave you on the counter. You paid with one thousand-yen note, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一枚だけです。硬貨は六百円で、札が一千円あります。自分の財布の札を加えたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払い千円一枚と受領硬貨札を財布混入なしで具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, just one. There are six hundred yen in coins and a thousand-yen note. I haven't added a note from my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the single thousand-yen payment and received coins and note, with no money mixed in from your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録も確認しました。余分に一千円札をお渡ししていました。申し訳ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked the record too. We gave you an extra thousand-yen note. I'm sorry.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認できてよかったです。余分な一枚はこちらへ返します。硬貨六百円は自分の釣銭として受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過払い確認後余分千円を返し正規六百円だけ受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm glad we checked. I'll return the extra note here and accept the six hundred yen in coins as my correct change.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After confirmation, return the extra thousand yen and keep only the correct six hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらが料金四百円の控えです。ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Here is your receipt for the four-hundred-yen charge. Please check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四百円と書いてあります。荷物の料金も取り消したのではなく、釣銭だけを直したということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四百円控えを見て料金取消しでなく釣銭修正と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says four hundred yen. So the luggage charge hasn't been canceled; only the change was corrected, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the four-hundred-yen receipt and confirm correction of change rather than cancellation of the charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。荷物の受付はそのまま済んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The luggage acceptance remains completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。控えと六百円を財布へ入れました。荷物はもう預けたので、釣銭確認のために持ち帰る必要もありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えと正規釣銭を収納し受付済荷物を持戻す必要がないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I've put the receipt and six hundred yen in my wallet. Since I've already left the luggage, I don't need to take it back just to check the change, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put away the receipt and correct change and check that accepted luggage does not need to be taken back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのままお預かりしています。それでは、ご確認ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we're still holding it as before. Thank you for checking. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高の資料についてのお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about balance documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。応募先の案内には先月末時点と書いてあります。今は給料が入って増えていますが、現在の数字を書けばよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募先の先月末基準に対し給与後の現残高を使えるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The application instructions say “as of the end of last month.” My balance has increased since my salary arrived, and I'm unsure whether I should write the current figure.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using the current post-salary balance when the application requires the end of last month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 応募先がどの日付を求めているかは、その案内に合わせて確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The date required by the application recipient needs to be checked against those instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月末という指定を、残高が多い今日へ変えてよいとは書いていません。先月末の数字を確認できる資料について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定を都合よい今日へ変えず過去数字の資料確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It doesn't say I can change the specified end of last month to today, when my balance is higher. I'd like to ask about documents that can confirm last month's closing figure.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not replace the specified date with a favorable current date; request information on documents for the past figure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行できる資料と対象の日付を担当が確認します。案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check which documents can be issued and the applicable date. Do you have the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 印刷したものを持っています。住所や他の記載もありますが、先に必要な日付の部分をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参案内の必要基準日部分を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a printout. It also includes an address and other details, but first I'll show the part with the required date.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the required reference-date section of the instructions you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望は担当へお伝えします。その資料で応募できると、こちらから保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll pass your request to the staff. We cannot guarantee that the document will be accepted for your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行が出せる資料の確認と、応募先が受け付ける形式の確認は別ですね。形式が違えば、応募先へ質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行発行可否と応募先受付形式を分け後者は先方へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So checking what the bank can issue and checking the format the application recipient accepts are separate. If the format differs, I'll ask the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish bank issuance from the recipient's accepted format, and check the latter with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発行にかかる日数や費用も、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will also explain the time and fees for issuing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料を今日必ず受け取れるとは考えず、日数を聞いて応募先の期限と比べます。まず指定の日付を変えずに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即日取得を期待せず発行日数費用と応募期限を比べて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume I can definitely receive it today. I'll ask how long it takes and compare it with the application deadline. First, I'll discuss it without changing the specified date.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not expect same-day receipt; compare issuance time and fees with the application deadline when discussing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、資料発行の担当へおつなぎします。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll connect you to the document-issuance staff member. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのお花は、湖へお供えするご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to offer those flowers to the lake?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 亡くなった父が好きだった湖を見に来ました。少し花を水へ流して思い出したいですが、する前にこちらで聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 故人父と湖の思い出を花の放流で偲ぶ前に案内員へ可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to see the lake my late father loved. I'd like to float a few flowers on the water in his memory, but I want to ask here before doing so.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the guide whether you may float flowers to remember your late father and the lake before doing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、花も含めて物を湖へ流さず、持ち帰っていただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, we ask visitors not to put anything into the lake, including flowers, and to take everything home.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花ならそのまま流してよいと思っていましたが、やめます。父を思う気持ちまでやめる必要はないので、別の過ごし方を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 放流を断念し追悼自体は別の形で続けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought flowers could be floated as they are, but I won't. I don't have to stop remembering my father, so I'll think of another way to spend the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give up floating the flowers and say that you wish to continue remembering him in another way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花を手元に持ちながら、こちらの休憩場所で湖を見ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also look at the lake from this rest area while holding your flowers.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこへ行きます。花を置いて帰るのではなく、持ったまま少し座り、父と来た時のことを思い出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花を置き去りにせず持って休憩場所で父の思い出を考えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll go there. Rather than leaving the flowers behind, I'd like to sit briefly holding them and remember when I came with my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the flowers rather than leaving them, and ask to remember your father at the rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの包みが風で飛ばないよう、荷物も手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep your belongings with you too so the wrapping you have doesn't blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花の包みもかばんへ収めました。人の通り道へ花や紙を残す形にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 風で飛ぶ包みも収納し通路へ花紙を残さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the flower wrapping in my bag too. I won't leave flowers or paper in people's walking path.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put away the wrapping that might blow away, and do not leave flowers or paper in the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りの際には、花も包みもお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When leaving, please take both the flowers and wrapping with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、全部持って帰ります。家で家族へ、湖へ花を流したのではなく、湖を見ながら父を思う時間を持てたと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花包み持帰りを確認し放流でなく湖を見て偲んだと家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll take everything home. I'll tell my family I didn't float flowers on the lake, but was able to spend time remembering my father while looking at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will take flowers and wrapping home, and tell your family you remembered him while looking at the lake rather than floating flowers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ静かな時間をお過ごしください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy a quiet moment. Have a safe journey home.
